after_contact.reason: Effective kinetic friction for a bag sliding up the deck, from a constant-deceleration fit.

into_hole.label: Into the hole
into_hole.note: The bag hung on the lip for 1.20 s, then dropped through the hole. It shrank from view as it tipped in.

model_note: Drag-free fit misses the measured path by 15.7 px RMS; predicting the second half from the first half misses by 83.1 px RMS. The bag slows horizontally in the image (8% of its vertical acceleration). Drag and the bag moving away from the camera both cause this; one camera cannot separate them.
